| Quarter (FY 2022) | Reporting Period End | Unearned Fees (USD) |
|-------------------|----------------------|---------------------|
| **1Q 2022** (Q1) | Mar‑31‑2022 | **$1.426 billion** |
| **2Q 2022** (Q2) | Jun‑30‑2022 | **$1.211 billion** |

No other quarter in fiscal year 2022 reported unearned fees at or above $1.2 billion; the remaining quarters report amounts below that threshold.
